title: City transit budget expansion
overview: After months of negotiation the city council approved a new transit budget that commits 45 million dollars to bus rapid transit. [1][2] The city council approved a new transit budget on Tuesday evening after a lengthy public hearing. [1] The transit expansion approved this week represents the largest single investment in public transportation the city has made in a decade. [3]

key_findings.text: After months of negotiation the city council approved a new transit budget that commits 45 million dollars to bus rapid transit.
The city council approved a new transit budget on Tuesday evening after a lengthy public hearing.
The transit expansion approved this week represents the largest single investment in public transportation the city has made in a decade.
The plan allocates 45 million dollars to bus rapid transit over the next three years.
Transit officials confirmed construction would begin in early 2027 pending environmental review.
Opponents argued the money should instead go to road maintenance in outer neighborhoods.
